Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misclassified Puerto Rico as a separate country based on its ISO 3166-1 code (PR), despite acknowledging it is a U.S. territory. This led to the incorrect conclusion that the airports are in different countries. In standard geopolitical terms, Puerto Rico is part of the United States, so both airports are in the same country (the United States).
